notes: Gas totals combine Polygon-fork transaction receipts with the later Polygon-mainnet seal estimate documented below.
Role split assigns the separately estimated contract-creation gas to deployer and all remaining measured migration gas to owner.
CORE seal gas replaces the fork measurement with the September 19, 2026 Polygon mainnet eth_estimateGas value of 16548157 for each of five chapters.

The Originals-only selective cutover baseline was measured independently on a Polygon fork after chapters 1-2 were staged; it includes MainReader deployment and chapter-1-only owner wiring while chapters 2-5 remain unchanged.
The safety factor covers moderate gas-estimate and base-fee movement; it is not a spending target.
